description.value:
Cost: 2,500eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

Corporate hit squads are sometimes described as a ‘hive mind’ that follow orders without question. Nowadays, that hive mind is real.

Neuralware. This cyberware requires linking to the Neuroport of at least one other user with this installed for either user’s to function. Linking to another Neuroport requires being within 6m/yds of the other user for at least 9 seconds (3 Rounds), and must be done voluntarily by both users. The link remains active for 24 hours or until either user cuts the connection, whichever comes first. Up to 6 users can be linked between each other in a single network simultaneously.

While linked users are within 20m/yds of each other, regardless of line of sight, all linked users gain a +1 Complimentary Bonus they may use once per Round on any Skill Check. All linked users also benefit from any cyberware that at least one other linked user has active which boosts external senses, detects movement, or scans for signals.

Bonuses from such cyberware only apply once to each user, and do not stack from multiple linked users. Linked users do not benefit from any other linked user’s cyberware which negates the effects of any Critical Injury or similar affliction (Anti-Dazzle, Cyberspine, etc).

Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
